notes: Two taḥwīl routes, each written in full: the first ends at «أبي سعيد الخدري»; the second adds the co-transmitters أبو سلمة and الضحاك الهمداني before «أن أبا سعيد الخدري»
«ح .» after the first route is the convergence mark; the saying is one (the Dhu al-Khuwaysira story), relayed by Abu Sa'id, the last link
«وكان» and the Companion named inside the saying (عمر، علي) are not links; the Prophet is the end
